aarch64-cuda.notes: UNMEASURED — derived from upstream guidance, not benchmarked. No HomeBrain box with this platform tag exists yet; treat every number here as a starting point, not a result. Rationale for each departure from the x86_64-vulkan flags: no -ot (128 GB unified holds the whole model, so nothing goes to CPU — the offload regex exists only because 16 GB cannot), -ngl 999 (same reason), full 131072 context (the 81920 cap is a VRAM-eviction ceiling that does not apply), --no-mmap (effectively mandatory on unified memory), -ub 2048 (upstream DGX Spark tuning), --threads 10 (the 10 Cortex-X925 performance cores, not all 20). min_healthy_vram_mb is deliberately not restated and so inherits 15000 from the model, which is inert here — verify_llama_allocation skips the watermark entirely on unified memory, which is the single place that guard belongs. Benchmark before trusting.

benchmark.measured_on: AMD RX 9060 XT, AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-core, Vulkan + RADV_PERFTEST=rm_kq=1, llama.cpp b10107, q8 KV, -ub 2048, -ot blk.20-39, ctx 81920, whisper on CPU
benchmark.notes: DEFAULT (2026-07-25). Moved from -ub 4096/b9381 to -ub 2048/b10107 after the shipped ub4096 config was measured EVICTING 1-in-2 on the pinned build itself (guarded, single-server, drained: 28.7 t/s sustained on a good run vs 22.2 t/s and VRAM -477 MiB on a bad one, from a byte-identical starting allocation). -ub 2048 is deterministic instead: two runs produced identical idle (15197) and identical post-fill (15230) VRAM, 2/2 PASS on b10107, 3/3 on b9381. Net vs the old default's GOOD runs: sustained TG 28.7 -> 29.0, headroom 898 -> 1107 MiB, deep-fill PP 565 -> 625, and the 50%% eviction risk removed. The one cost is shallow-prompt PP@2k 758 -> 618 (-19%%); the micro-batch is what sizes the compute buffer, and that buffer relocating to GTT mid-fill was the whole failure. For maximum margin (headroom 2231) use -ot blk.18-39 with -ub 2048 at ~-4%% TG. See docs/BENCHMARKS.md (2026-07-25).

benchmark.measured_on: AMD RX 9060 XT, AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-core, DDR4, Vulkan + RADV_PERFTEST=rm_kq=1, llama.cpp b9186/b9381, ngl=99, MTP n_max=2, ctx 32768
benchmark.notes: Hybrid DeltaNet SSM+attn (16/64 standard attn layers, 48 DeltaNet). RS must stay GPU-local — nkvo breaks DeltaNet fused kernel (garbage output). ngl<99 drops to ~2 t/s; partial offload defeats DeltaNet GPU fusion. ctv/ctk with fa is mandatory on AMD Vulkan. MTP CLIFF: the draft-mtp speculative path accelerates ONLY at ctx <= ~34816 (cliff between 34816 and 36864); above it TG snaps back to the ~17.5 baseline. ctx was 49152 (over the cliff, MTP gave ~+2%); lowered to 32768 to capture the full MTP gain: ~17.1 -> ~30 t/s (+75%) with n_max=2, q4_0 KV. Crossing any of {ctx>~35K, n_max>=3, q8 KV} silently disables speculation. NOT fixed by b9381 (DeltaNet-specific; the MoE 35B cliff WAS fixed by b9381). See docs/BENCHMARKS.md '27B cliff localization'.
